name: Obby: Hide and Seek, Battle Royale 🕹️ Play on CrazyGames
author: CrazyGames
description: Obby: Hide and Seek, Battle Royale is a playful action game where you can run, hide, and transform into anything around you to escape detection. Explore huge levels filled with secrets, use pets and magic equipment like invisibility, freezing, or acceleration to outsmart rivals, and level up your character for stronger abilities.
